# Fixture rules (harmonic-forge#495)

Hand-written, small, and deliberately about DIFFERENT subjects so the ranker
has something to be right or wrong about. Real rule files are 100+ rules on one
protocol; a fixture that reproduced that would pin the tests to a corpus whose
vocabulary statistics nobody controls.

<!-- R-9001 -->
Always create a dedicated disposable implementation worktree per issue. Never
edit inside the shared lane worktree, and never branch-switch inside it.
<!-- /R-9001 -->

<!-- R-9002 -->
Include the operator's scheduling link in every outreach message. Never
substitute a different booking product.
<!-- /R-9002 -->

<!-- R-9003 -->
Sentiment scoring degrades gracefully when the local model runtime is
unavailable: connection error, out-of-memory, and timeout each fall back to a
neutral modifier rather than failing the ingest.
<!-- /R-9003 -->
